product.name: Once Weathered 50-75mm Exterior Return Concrete Coping Stone by Eurodec
product.description: Fantastic for parapet wall corners that need rainwater transported away from the installation, this Eurodec once weathered coping stone is 75mm thick on the inner side and 50mm thick on the outside edge of the stone. A slope is formed, in turn allowing rainwater to run away from the property. This protects the wall from water damage and staining.The array of colours means that you can suit your exterior coping stone to the aesthetic of your garden and home while simultaneously protecting the top layer of masonry for wall corners. Equipped with two 10mm wide drip grooves on either side of the stone's undersides, further protection is added to the wall. It helps to resist water penetration and staining by directing the water away. The high-strength, smooth concrete cap delivers a decorative and professional finish to projects and keeps walls protected from water damage while supporting the overall structures. You can coordinate this product with Eurodec's range of flat and weathered concrete coping stones.The product is handmade from natural, quarried materials. Due to this, some colours may vary slightly from one batch to the next. The final finish of the stone is not complete until it has undergone a period of exposure to sunlight and weathering. Eurodec coping stones can effectively resist the sun's UV rays in a common UK climate, which may cause fading over time.Features & Benefits: Weathered 4 Way 125mm Concrete Pier Cap by EurodecDifferent colours and sizes availableHandmade four-way weathered pier capOffers a decorative finish to gate pillars and parapet wallsResists UV damage in common UK climate conditionsWeathered four times for a symmetrical tapered effectDrip grooves guide rainwater away from the wallWith two drip grooves on either side of the stone, it allows rainwater to easily drip to the floor and away from your wall. In turn, damage and staining are significantly reduced. Please note: Acid-based cleaners must not be used on Eurodec Concrete Coping Stones.It is advised that you test any cleaner on a small area before using it. Similarly, you must avoid high-pressure washers as the jet can damage the stone's surface and weaken the bond between the stone and substrate.Staining can also arise from plants in the immediate vicinity.

product.name: Twice Weathered 50-75mm Concrete Coping Stone by Eurodec Return
product.description: With a variety of decorative colour tone options to choose from, you can create a delightfully stylish finish for your parapet wall or garden thanks to this 50-75mm Twice Weathered Coping Stone Return from Eurodec.Not only does this twice-weathered coping return ensure you can maintain your coping stone design around corners, but it is also an efficient form of weather protection for the top layer of your wall. With 75mm thickness at the apex and 50mm thickness at the sides, it allows rainwater to run off effectively. Due to the handmade construction methods, it is subject to manufacturers’ tolerances including when the stones are lifted from their moulds, they will have a slight tapering of no more than 10mm at the corners.Features & Benefits: Twice Weathered 50-75mm Concrete Coping Stone by Eurodec ReturnOffers protection to the top corner sections of a wallKeeps a consistent aesthetic with the rest of the wall75mm thick at the apex and 50mm thick at the sidesAllows rainwater to run off efficientlyFeatures drip grooves to help rainwater drip away from the wallUV resistant in standard climate conditionsTwice weathered coping stone returnHandmade from solid concreteAvailable in a variety of colour tonesFeaturing two 10mm wide drip grooves situated 20mm from either side of its undersides, this coping stone will help to protect your walls from water penetration which, over time, can cause staining and damage. Instead of letting rainwater run down the sides of the stones and underneath towards the wall, it can drip down to the ground as it reaches the drip groove which provides protection for your wall.Made to order, this Eurodec coping stone is resilient against fading caused by UV rays in standard climate conditions. As it’s fabricated from natural, quarried materials, there will be variations in colour in different batches. This stone will not reveal its complete finish until it has been exposed to sunlight and some weather over time.Please note: You must not use acid-based cleaners on Eurodec Concrete Coping Stones.You are advised to test any cleaner on a small area before using it. You must also avoid high-pressure washers as the jet can damage the stone’s surface and weaken the bond between the substrate and stone.Staining can occur from plants in the immediate vicinity.

product.name: Wallbarn Universal Extra Adjustable Pedestal for Decking and Paving
product.description: Wallbarn’s Universal  Extra adjustable pedestal range is suitable for both paving and decking. They are particularly ideal for porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiums. Even flat roofs are built to a small fall to allow adequate drainage. The adjustable pedestals have a telescopic stem which allow you to make millimetre-precise manual adjustments in height in order to achieve a flat upper surface. Universal Extra pedestals are a freestanding system, so no fixings are made through the membrane underneath, ideal for warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systems. They also come with an integrated acoustic shim on the headpiece. The pedestals create a cavity between the sub-deck and the paving/decking surface which helps ventilate the structure and allows services such as pipes and cables to be hidden from view.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Universal Extra Adjustable Pedestal for Decking and PavingSuitable for paving and decking, including porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiumsAdjustable telescopic stem for precise height adjustmentsUniversal Extra pedestals are freestanding, meaning no fixings through the membraneIdeal for warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systemsIntegrated acoustic shim on the headpieceCreates a cavity for ventilation and hiding pipes and cablesHeight markings every 10mm on stems for easy adjustmentEach pedestal includes an extension shankMaximum load is 11,493 N (1,171 kg)Wallbarn's Universal EXTRA pedestals give installers greater flexibility when working across surfaces with very large differences in deck level as the height range is far greater across just three products: 85mm-135mm, 125mm-215mm and 210mm-380mm.Often installers cannot be sure exactly where the fall will be on the roof or by how much. These pedestals have the heights marked out every 10mm on the side of stems, so users can see at a glance the exact height they are adjusting to without having to constantly re-measure. Each EXTRA pedestal comes complete with an extension shank which clicks into the baseplate. The threaded stem is then placed into the top of it. Paving applicationsPositioning lugs create uniform spacing between each slab, allowing rainwater to run between and under the slabs, so no standing water is left on the surfaceBeing a suspended system, the weight of the slab holds everything in placeHeight adjustments can be made whilst the slab is in place, saving time and labour10mm high lugs mean they are ideal for supporting thin tilesLugs can be snapped by hand for stretcher bond and irregular laying patternsLaying deckingAdjusting the height of the pedestals, rather than cutting furring’s means installers can install decking onto structural decks much more quicklyPedestals are adjusted to accommodate the fall in the roof deckPlaced a maximum of 600mm apart, the joist bearers are simply slotted between the joist holdersA joist framework is constructed to create a sturdy, stable, weight-bearing surface to take the upper surfacingThe top decking is then fixed onto the joists using ordinary wood screws or hidden fixingsHeight adjustments can be made whilst the timber joist framework is in place, saving time and labourRaising the decking off the sub-deck allows water to drain freely under the decking so there is no standing water left on the surface, preventing ponding and associated slip hazards, and extending the lifespan of the timber.Joists are not standing directly on the waterproofing membrane, or insulation, preventing damage to it.

product.name: Wallbarn TD Minipad Adjustable Support Pad
product.description: The TD Minipad Adjustable Support Pad by Wallbarn is an effective solution for your suspended timber decking system. Manufactured from high-quality virgin fibre injection-moulded polypropylene, these support pads are engineered to ensure excellent strength and durability, offering incredible weight tolerance of up to 683kg.Designed with precision and innovation in mind, the TD Minipad is ideal for areas with low height thresholds, where minor height adjustments are required for a flawless finish. It supports timber joists for top surface deck boards, making it perfect for balconies, terraces, and podium decks. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn TD Minipad Adjustable Support PadIdeal for suspended timber decking systemsMade from high-quality virgin fibre injection-moulded polypropyleneImpressive weight tolerance of up to 683kgPrecise millimetre-height adjustments with telescopic stemsDiiferent sizes availableSuitable for balconies, terraces, and podium decksFast and easy installation, saving time and labour150mm diameter headpieces and baseplates for stabilityEnhanced drainage, ventilation, and concealed space for servicesWhat sets the TD Minipad apart is its millimetre-precise height adjustment capabilities. The telescopic stems allow for easy and fast installation, enabling you to achieve the desired height with minimal effort. These adjustable support pads save you both time and labour during construction, as adjustments can be made while the timber joists are in place. The 150mm diameter headpieces and baseplates ensure stability and reliability.In addition to its functionality, the TD Minipad offers enhanced drainage with its suspended system, preventing standing water on the surface. It creates a cavity beneath the decking, providing ventilation and concealed space for pipes and cables.Please note: A range of different lug size, slope correctors, levelling shims and accessories are available for use with TD Megapads from Wallbarn.Wallbarn recommends that TD Minipads should be positioned a maximum of 600mm apart.

product.name: Wallbarn Protecto-Drain 20m Cavity Drain Membrane
product.description: The Wallbarn Protecto-Drain 8 Cavity Drain Membrane is a perfect solution for safeguarding foundations, basements, and subterranean structures. This dimpled HDPE membrane, also known as a Cavity Drain or Fin Drain, offers superior protection against mechanical damage while creating a vital air gap between the waterproofing and the earth.This innovative design establishes a reliable drainage channel, preventing hydrostatic pressure buildup within the structure, ensuring a dry and robust foundation. product.name: Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Pedestal For Decking and Paving
product.description: Available in a selection of height options, this Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Paving and Decking Support from Wallbarn is designed to form flat surfaces for paved or decked structures. While especially suited to use alongside porcelain tiles on podiums and flat roofs, these pedestals provide adjustments that are precise to the millimetre with the telescopic stem across various flat surfaces.The free-standing system requires no fixings, in turn sparing below membranes from hindrance and suiting warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systems. The pedestals create a gap between the paving or decking and the sub-deck for the purpose of ventilation, while effectively hiding unpleasant pipes and cables.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Pedestal For Decking and PavingVirgin fibre injection moulded polypropylene structureCompressive Strength between +20°C and -40°CCost-effective and sturdyEnd of Linear Behaviour: 6,700N = 683kgWeight Tolerance: Maximum Load 11,493 N = 1,171kg200mm base plate diameter and 120mm headpiece diameter55mm distance between lugs which are 10mm x 2mm (4mm upon request)-40°C to 75°CIntegrated acoustic shim on the headpieceLaying DeckingAdjusting the pedestal height instead of cutting furring’s quickens installation and accommodates falls in the roof deck. Joist bearers easily slot between joist holders when situated a maximum of 600mm apart. A joist framework is formed for a sturdy, stable, weight-bearing surface to take the upper surfacing and the top decking can then be fixed onto the joists with wood screws or discrete fixings. You can make height adjustments when the timber joist framework is in place to reduce both time and labour. Raising the decking off the sub-deck lets water drain beneath the decking to: avoid standing water on the surface, prolong timber lifespan, stop ponding, and limit resulting slip hazards. Joists are not standing directly on the waterproofing membrane, or insulation, to avoid damage.Standards & CertificationConforms to quality management systems standard UNI EN ISO 9001 2008Fire rating classed as 'EUROCLASSE E' according to EN 135011 2009.

product.name: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain Outlet
product.description: Available in different lengths and diameters, this perforated roof drain outlet from Wallbarn is made of flexible and strong TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer). It works to add a waterproof element to drainage holes on both balconies and roofs that are already equipped with bituminous waterproofing membranes. With resilience to weathering and UV rays, this outlet can withstand temperature changes up to 120°C and resist brittleness in lower temperatures.Where holes are made in concrete decks, this outlet is easily installed after a layer of waterproof membrane and then coated with a second layer on top of the flange - which has a perforated edge for the membrane to settle in for a secure and sturdy bond. The 240mm shank fits into an HDPE (High-density polyethylene) pipe snuggly and is slightly coned to ease the fit and provide additional stability. Water is prevented from travelling back up thanks to the two rings that emulate a drain tap, and the serrated area allows for a drain guard to join the system.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain OutletMade from TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer) for durability, resilience, and waterproofingInstalled alongside two layers of a waterproofing membranePerforated flange to help bondingConed shank with serrated area to ease installation and allow for drain guardsUV stable and able to withstand high (120°C) and low temperatures.Compatible with SBS (Styrene Butadiene Styrene) and APP (Atactic Polypropylene Membrane) membranes, such as built-up (felt), hot melt, mastic asphalt, and other liquid-applied membranes.Please note: Do not allow direct contact with concrete as this can allow water to find its way beneath the outlet and cause damage.Assure that a layer of membrane is fully bonded to the outlet flange and the first layer for completely watertight bonds.

product.name: Wallbarn TPE Extension Shank
product.description:
Wallbarn extension shanks are designed to fix up with the drainage outlets to increase the reach into the parapet wall or drainage channel.
Often the ducts and channels will have to pass through a long run of concrete before reaching a suitable area to install the HDPE drainpipe, so an extension of a fully waterproof sealed connector will be required. These extension shanks are specially designed to fit in with the full range of Wallbarn circular outlets.
They are made from TPE but can still be used with EPDM and PVC outlets. They are manufactured to a slight cone shape, so the end of the circular outlet slots inside the top of the extension shank. The two membranes are bonded together using silicone adhesive.
Please note: Installers of PVC waterproofing systems should always inform waterproofing manufacturer before using these two materials together in order check the status of the warranty.

product.name: Wallbarn Adjustable Paving Minipad
product.description: Wallbarn Adjustable Paving Minipads are designed to create level suspended paving systems where installation heights are restricted. product.name: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable Pedestal
product.description: The specially designed Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA adjustable pedestals are ideal for decking and paving projects. The self-levelling headpieces have been developed to give extra scope and flexibility, so differences are accommodated within the surface beneath the pedestal. The BALANCE also helps alleviate blemishes and ridges in the sub-deck or changes in the thickness of your paving slabs which makes the upper surface uneven.Whereas BALANCE pedestals are available in heights from 25mm up to 395mm, BALANCE EXTRA pedestals give an extended height range from 100mm up to 395mm in just three different products.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable PedestalIdeal for decking and pavingEasier and faster than old fashioned methodsSpecially designed to give extra scope and flexibilityHeight: 222mm - 392mm, 137mm - 227mm, 97mm - 147mmType: AdjustableThis suspended system uses the weight of the slab or decking to hold everything into place. Rainwater runs between and underneath, so there is no standing water left on the surface of your floor. This dramatically reduces the risk of slipping and causing serious injury.You can hide unsightly objects such as cables, water pipes and drainage outlets underneath the paving slabs as well, improving the aesthetics of your floor.Decking ApplicationsWhen used with timber decking systems, the lugs(fins) are set out towards the edges of the headpiece to give a 55mm gap between each one. This allows a timber joist to fit between the lugs (fins), and then decking boards are can be fixed to the joist frame. Installers are able to create decking surfaces onto structural decks much faster by adjusting the height of pedestals rather than cutting furrings.Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece design has four positioning lugs (fins) laid out in a crucifix formation set towards the edges of the headpiece. The design means that it robust, stable and durable. The headpiece has separate parts that allow up to 5% or 2.86 degrees of slope correction in all directions. This allows smooth movement and positioning of the paving slab. Slips and sharp tilting are avoided owing to the superior design and solid manufacture. The lugs (fins) separate paving slabs and tiles on the headpiece to allow sufficient drainage between slabs, which create a uniform paving line, so the slabs are laid entirely straight. A rubber anti-shock pad can slot onto the headpiece to give a better grip to the slab and help insulate against vibration and noise travelling through to the deck beneath.Please note: Shims, slope correctors, cross spacers and other accessories can also be used with the BALANCE Pedestals.

product.name: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking Pedestal
product.description: Wallbarn's Mega Balance Self-Levelling Pedestals are an easy-to-install four-in-one solution that you can use in various applications, thanks to its ingenious headpiece design that supports not only decking joists and bearers but also paving slabs and tiles.With a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mm, this heavy-duty suspended system means the weight of the paving slabs or tiles ballasts themselves securely into position. Each pedestal is made from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillers, which will provide long-term durability and performance. They have even been laboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking PedestalAn easy-to-install pedestal that supports both decking boards and paving slabs/tilesA self-levelling and fixed head pedestal all in oneHas a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mmSelf-levelling headpiece moves up to 5% or 2.86° in all directionsYou can adjust your pedestals slightly even after a project has been completed, saving on labour and improving health and safetyThe ‘grey nut’ can be pressed into the centre of the headpiece to lock the self-levelling mechanism should installers require fixed headsThe headpiece comes with an integrated rubber anti-shock pad, which clicks into place to give a better grip and improves vibration and noise insulationMade from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillersLaboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures1 black nut for every four units purchased.While the headpiece is self-levelling as standard, by using the 'grey nut', the head can be locked rigid within the same unit. If you need to adjust the height of your pedestals, you can do this using the 'yellow' and 'silver' key tools, even on a completed paving project, without having to lift and remove any of the slabs.For Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece incorporates 4 x 4mm wide positioning lugs (fins) integrated with the headpiece, helping to create a uniform paving line for your slabs and tiles. Not only does it aid the overall aesthetic of your paving, but with the headpiece’s lugs separating your tiles, this allows for improved drainage. To install, simply lay the paving slab or tile onto one segment of the headpiece so four corners of your paving slabs or tiles rest on each headpiece. This will ensure four pedestals support each corner of a slab or tile, providing stable and secure support. For Decking ApplicationsThe four positioning lugs on the self-levelling headpiece are set 55mm apart so a 50mm wide joist/bearer can be loose-laid between them easily. It is loose-laid rather than mechanically fixed in case of expansion or movement, which can cause differences between the structure beneath and the decking over time. The lugs are high enough to house the joists securely, giving you flexibility in your decking project. When laying your decking, the joists/bearers should be cross-fitted together to form a secure framework. The upper surface decking boards can then be mechanically fixed to the joist frame according to the specification and assembly instructions of the deck board supplier. Standards & CertificationFire Classification: EUROCLASS E according to EN 13501-1-2009Please note: You will only receive 1 black nut for every four units purchased. Additional black Nuts can be purchased.In decking applications, there is no need to cut furrings as the pedestals are adjusted in height to create a flat frame level.The headpiece is self-levelling as standard. Installers may or may not wish to click the grey nut into the headpiece to lock the head, depending on the characteristics of the decking project.There are cut lines on the underside of the baseplates should installers need to pave directly up to walls or parapets - do not cut bases beyond these cut lines.Special CLASS B1 (EN 13501-1-2009) rated pedestals can be manufactured upon request.

product.name: Everbuild Evercryl One Coat Acrylic Waterproof Coating
product.description: Available in a choice of sizes, this resin-based and fibre re-enforced Evercryl One Coat Acrylic Waterproof Coating is a roofing solution from Everbuild that is ideal for addressing common roofing problems. It is highly versatile and can be used on various roofing surfaces, providing instant repairs even on wet surfaces. The application process is simple with Evercryl being brush-applied, drying to a seamless and flexible membrane that is incredibly smooth and discourages the growth of algae and fungi. Thanks to its high level of fibre reinforcement, Evercryl can be implemented to bridge small cracks, and needs just a single-coat brush application to provide rapid and complete water protection - even in places that are prone to ponding. Features & Benefits: Everbuild Evercryl One Coat Acrylic Waterproof CoatingNo primer is needed on sound non-porous surfaces, saving you time and effortCan be applied in wet or frosty conditions down to -5°C for immediate leak repairEasily brush applied and dries to a smooth, flexible membrane, instantly waterproof, preventing wash off during applicationWhen applied, Evercryl becomes instantly waterproof, preventing any concern for wash off. This feature allows for emergency leaks to be addressed without waiting for the rain to stop. Additionally, Evercryl does not need a primer when applied to sound non-porous surfaces, making it a hassle-free option for roofing repairs.Evercryl is particularly suited to general sealing, maintenance and repair work, and waterproofing of most typical roofs in wet or dry conditions. It is compatible with fibre/cement, mastic asphalt, concrete, roofing felt, existing bituminous roof coatings and rigid PVCu, as well as corrugated iron, metals, slates, tiles, brickwork, copper, lead and zinc. You can also use Evercryl for waterproofing guttering (plastic and metal), downpipes, upstands, vents, gullies, leadwork and flashings.

product.name: Titan D400 Ducting Access Chamber - 150mm Depth
product.description: Made from reprocessed, co-polymer polypropylene, this Titan Ducting Access Chamber is a resilient inspection chamber that effortlessly surpasses the demands of BSEN124 D400 load rating, showcasing its remarkable durability and adaptability across a vast spectrum of applications and eliminating the necessity for a concrete surround.When setting up this chamber, ensure the opening is approximately 100mm deeper than the chamber’s required depth, incorporating the lid and frame. The width at the base of the opening should closely match the exterior dimensions of the Titan box section, allowing for an approximate 25mm allowance for adjustment. With the pavement level, maintain an excess of 100mm to 150mm over the Titan box section being utilised.Features & Benefits: Titan D400 Ducting Access Chamber - 150mm DepthMade from reprocessed, co-polymer polypropyleneExceeds BSEN124 D400 load ratingEliminates the need for concrete surround150mm depthSuitable for a wide range of applicationsHeavy-duty constructionEach wall contains entry ports at 110mmThe chamber’s foundation can be created by employing a C30 dry mix at a 100mm depth, leaving a small aperture in the base to function as a natural soakaway. For optimal height and tilt customisation, consider utilising a galvanised steel frame with a composite lid. By situating the frame within the chamber and lifting it to the desired level, you can achieve a 100mm adjustment with each frame. Envelop the frame with C30 concrete for added stability.Pole boxes come in two standard sizes: 300mm x 300mm x 450mm deep and 450mm x 450mm x 450mm deep. However, custom sizes are also available upon request. The pole boxes securely encircle the traffic signal through a specially fabricated wrap-around jaw, and concreting the traffic signal pole is strongly advised for optimal performance and support.Please note: The images are provided by Plastech Ltd.

product.name: Water Based Deck Adhesive for ClassicBond
product.description:
This high strength low odour water based acrylic adhesive is specifically designed for use with ClassicBond and Firestone EPDM roofing membranes to a range of deck surfaces.
Designed to be roller applied to flat roof surfaces.
ClassicBond WBA will bond ClassicBond EPDM membrane to a range of conventional timber roof surfaces e.g. plywood, OSB. All boards should be resistant to moisture but not sealed with adhesive repellent waxes or other non-absorbent systems. If in doubt a small test area should be laid. Certain roof surfaces may not be suitable for use with this adhesive, for example, non-porous roof decks or those of low vapour permeability, i.e. metal or existing GRP.

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Naylor's land drain pipe filter sock geotextile is a great addition to pipe systems. Particularly in sandy and silty soil conditions.A special knit fabric, this sock allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe, then subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with water. The fabric prevents larger soil particles from passing through the fabric, causing a bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. An example of this is granular backfill materials.  The bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials and immediately surrounds the perforated drainage pipe.Features & Benefits: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock GeotextileSuitable for sandy and silty soil conditionsKnit fabricPrevents large soil particles from passing throughAllows fine soil particles to pass through

product.name: Naylor Land Drainage Coil Pipe
product.description: From Naylor, this land drain coil pipe is ideal for use as a collector drain – particularly in the removal of surplus water that builds on the surface of fields and gardens to an appropriate collection point. product.name: Naylor Pre-Loaded Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description:
The specially knit fabric allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe that are subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with the water. The remaining larger soil particles that are blocked from passing through the fabric, bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. Like granular backfill materials, the bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials immediately surrounding the perforated drainage pipe. It is particularly suited for use in sandy and silty soil conditions.

Prevents Clogging - Keeps water flowing
Screens out sand & sediment
No need For special backfill
Millions of meters in use worldwide
Residential

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Designed to complement Naylor Land Drain Pipes, this 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile is made from a specially knit fabric, which offers a unique solution by allowing ultra-fine soil particles to effortlessly flow through, joining the perforated pipe. As water flows, these fine particles are efficiently carried away, ensuring optimal drainage performance. What's more, this Filter Sock Geotextile also plays a crucial role in retaining larger soil particles. product.name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit
product.description:
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reaction (AVR) unit has been designed to limit noise levels and vibrations from diaphragm compressors used in the water and wastewater treatment sectors.
Suitable for all types of compressor including; Bibus Secoh, Nitto and Charles Austen, the Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit is easily fitted inline between the compressor and air diffuser. If space permits, the Marsh Whisspurr unit should be fitted as close as possible to the compressor – preferably, inside the sewage treatment plant.
Please note, the Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit is chemically sealed and bolted shut, which creates a pressure vacuum when in operation. Any tampering, breaking of the seal, or removal of any bolts will invalidate the warranty and will prevent the unit from working effectively. This unit is also not suitable for side channel blowers.
What are the benefits of the Marsh Whisppurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit?
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit’s innovative design ensures that any noise pollution emanating from the compressor unit is dramatically reduced without hindering the overall performance of the treatment system. Rural areas, where continuous noise is a nuisance, particularly benefits from AVR unit’s noise and vibration reduction qualities.
Available in four standard sizes, the corrosion free Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit does not require any electrics and can be easily installed into existing wastewater and water treatment systems.
Features and Benefits

Innovative UK design (patent pending).
Significantly reduces compressor volume and vibration without reducing in air pressure from the compressor.
No increase in back pressure to the compressor.
The unit contains no moving parts and requires no electrics.
Can be easily retrofitted to existing compressors.
Hose tail is 20mm standard.
Ideal for rural areas where noise pollution is a nuisance.
Available in four standard sizes.
Manufactured from resin and glass polymer, making the unit corrosion free and invulnerable to warm/humid conditions.
Unit is dark green as standard.

Specification
Overall unit width: 142mm
Overall unit height (excluding hose tail):200mm240mm350mm450mm
Material (unit): Resin and Glass Polymer
Material (hose tail connections): Brass with Stainless Steel nuts and bolts.
Colour: Dark Green

product.name: Marsh Cesspool Cesspit Tank
product.description:
The Marsh cesspool cesspit tank is a covered, watertight unit for storing raw household sewage. It has no outlet and relies on road transport for the removal of raw sewage. No biological treatment is involved.

Heavy duty shell as standard to enable installation in all ground conditions
Integral lifting eyes for improved on-site handling
Unique ‘keying-in’ lip to assist anchoring into granular or concrete surround

Modern environmental regulations either discourage or ban the use of cesspools (Cesspools are not permitted in Scotland), and instead connections to municipal sewage systems or package sewage treatment plants are encouraged or required.In many countries, planning and development regulations for the protection of the environment prevent home-owners who live close to rivers and environmentally sensitive areas from installing a cesspit or septic system, requiring a sewage treatment plant instead.
Please note, whoever empties your cesspool should be a registered Waste Carrier and hold a current discharge licence from the local water authority.

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.

The Marsh Ultra:Polylok L (UPL) draws upon Marsh Industries’ extensive experience in the industrial and commercial sewage treatment sectors bringing its outstanding performance and added-value engineering to the domestic sector.The Marsh UPL is available in either a 6PE or a 12PE model, is approved to BS EN12566-3 and carries an impressive effluent quality of 20:30:20, within national consentstandards.

Tested and approved to the most stringent European Standards: EN12566-3:2005+A1:2009

Variable inverts for ease of installation at various depths - 250, 500 and 750mm risers available
Pumped outlets available

product.name: Marsh Polylok Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The plant has low visual impact with unobtrusive lids. Easy access integral separate de-sludge pipe and almost silent running & odour free. Its is manufactured in the united kingdom & is backed with a 25 year structural guarantee. Invert risers and pumped outlets can be supplied for deeper drain connections. Designed with integral recycling system that makes it ideal for intermittent use.
Features

Endogeneous respiration, reducing the sludge and increasing the amount of dissolved oxygen in the primary chamber.
For Increased health and safety we fit our large plants with stabalising feet to protect the civil engineering installation team from being injured because of the movement and roll of the sewage treatment plant.
We fit kiddie-guards into our turrets to prevent either adults, children or animals falling into the plant during maintenance, this is an added assurance to our bolt down covers.
Carbon Vents will be fitted into our manhole covers reducing the need for external venting.
After the process is completed we fit a Polylok Tertiary Filter that reduces further the final suspended solids by 40% and further improves the final BOD.

Warranty & guarantee

The minimum design life of the tank structure is twenty five years. (internally & externally)
The compressor blower is covered by a two year guarantee.
The diffuser is covered by a five year guarantee.
Engineered using high performance materials.
All metal components stainless steel.

product.name: Marsh:Standard Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants are a cost-effective way of treating sewage and wastewater in an off-mains area. For large residential, commercial and industrial sites, including leisure sites, Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants will provide biological processing for effluent until it’s of a quality well within the British Water effluent standard.
This sewage treatment plant will provide effluent treatment for up to 85 people. Manufactured in the UK, the tank is made from GRP virgin unfilled resin to provide a durable and structurally secure tank that has consistent wall thickness and no fillers in the material. Built this way in part as a safety feature, Marsh:Standard plants also have turret guards and failure alarms for extra peace of mind.
A low energy compressor and high specification bacteria keep the Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plant running smoothly as the bacteria along with membrane diffusers ensure the circulation of effluent so that it’s all treated. The low energy compressor minimises running costs whilst the system needs minimal maintenance as the system itself has no moving parts.
Approved to BS12566, the heavy duty shell provides a long life for Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants. Alarms and 600mm lockable manhole covers are as standard.
